principle: Independent scientific admission of the exact F-MR20 parallel V1 candidate; correctness, isolation and hard mass are primary gates, performance is explicitly out of scope.

checks_each_case: canonical result identity by column id
positive_matrix.repeatability: A/B/A execution where A is 2 workers and B is 4 workers, starting from independently cloned identical committed states.
positive_matrix.batch_boundary_attack: Cases deliberately place canonical column order across different batch boundaries for the same logical population.

rejected_problem_columns: single locally rejected forcing at an interior canonical position
single locally rejected forcing at a batch boundary
two rejected columns assigned to different workers
requirements: unaffected columns remain bit-identical to serialized reference
rejected column committed state remains at pre-trial revision/state
one worker rejection cannot mutate another worker's column
shared immutable parameter registry remains bit-identical
heavy backend/executor/workspace ownership is per worker, not per column and not shared mutable state

unsupported_profile_rule: Must fail closed before any physical solve; no silent serialized fallback is accepted as parallel admission.

determinism.published_order: canonical column order independent of input/completion order

source_lock: No src/ change relative to immutable candidate is allowed in F-MQ26.
early_exit_rule: Any worker-count dependence, cross-column mutation, pre-solve fail-open, hard-mass failure or source drift is sufficient for NOT_QUALIFIED and must route back to F-MR.
explicit_nonclaims: root extraction, snow, macropores, frost, hysteresis, tabulated hydraulics or elasticity
